title: to do 与 doing 义变

questions.stem: Please remember ____ (lock) the door when you leave.
questions.explanation: 记得去做（还没做）→ remember to lock。

questions.stem: I forgot ____ (bring) my homework this morning, so the teacher was angry.

options.distractor: 作业没带来，是“忘了带”，用 to do

questions.explanation: 忘了去做（没做）→ forgot to bring。

questions.stem: He felt very tired, so he stopped ____ (have) a rest.

options.distractor: 这是“停止休息”，与“累了”矛盾

questions.explanation: 停下来去休息 → stopped to have a rest。

questions.stem: When the teacher came in, the students stopped ____ (talk).

options.distractor: 这里要“停止说话”，不是“停下来去说”

questions.explanation: 停止正在做的事 → stopped talking。

questions.stem: — Did you remember ____ the letter? — Yes, I remember ____ it on my way home.

options.distractor: 前后反了：先问“有没有记得去寄”，再答“记得寄过了”
第二空是“记得做过的事”

questions.explanation: 第一空还没寄（to post），第二空已寄过（posting）。

questions.stem: — The light in the classroom is still on. — Oh, I forgot ____ it off.

options.distractor: 灯还亮着说明没关，是“忘了去关”

questions.explanation: 忘了去做（没做）→ forgot to turn it off。
